Meme history - Okay Movement are a series of Vine remix videos featuring a clip of a grinning man timidly saying "okay," which is often used as a comedic device in conjunction with various footage from TV shows, music videos and films. Origin - On December 29th, 2014, Viner Lilianna Hogan posted a Vine clip taken during her vacation at the Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda, which begins with a panoramic view of the vista before panning over to her Rwandan tour guide who replies "okay" with a smile after she says "hi" in greeting.
